Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Measure
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Measure"** means to ascertain the size, amount, or degree of something. (मापना)

 
 
• **Example:** We need to** measure** the length of the table to ensure it fits in the room.
 
 
 
• **"Gauge"** refers to estimating or determining the magnitude, amount, or volume of something. (मापना)
 
 
• **Example:** The mechanic used a device to** gauge** the pressure in the car's tires.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the word **'measure**' is synonymous with** 'gauge'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Diagnose** (निदान करना): To identify the nature of an illness or other problem by examination.

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor was able to **diagnose** the illness after several tests.
 
 
 
• **Propel** (प्रेरित करना): To drive or push something forward.
 
 
• **Example:** The boat is** propelled **by a small motor.
 
 
 
• **Deviation** (विचलन): The action of departing from an established course or accepted standard.
 
 
• **Example:** Any **deviation **from the original plan needs to be approved.
